opportunities.title: Main Grants (Research, Development and Analysis Fund)

amount.raw: up to £500,000 (up to £750,000 in special cases, by prior agreement); most grants below £300,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK-based organisations/institutions. Not funded: individuals without formal employment or contractual relationship with the hosting institution, projects led by unaffiliated individuals, schools or FE colleges, undergraduates or master's students, PhD fees, establishment of academic posts, dissemination-only projects, local charities, requests for individual financial help. Overseas organisations only in exceptional cases with UK-focused dissemination plans.
opportunities.summary: Funding for research projects that address one or more of the Foundation's five priority questions and aim to improve lives in the UK. Two application deadlines a year (Spring and Autumn).

opportunities.title: Racial Diversity UK Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants from diverse backgrounds, particularly individuals and organisations from racially minoritised communities; partnership applications bringing together researchers and racially minoritised communities strongly encouraged.
opportunities.summary: Research funding to understand the barriers and pathways to a racially just and inclusive society in the UK. 2026 priority theme: inter-generational changes, continuities and challenges in racially diverse UK. One deadline a year (Autumn).
